info.title: Dokkan Backend API
info.description: Comprehensive API documentation for the Dokkan e-commerce platform.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of products with optional status and sort filters.

post.description: Creates a new product. Use multipart/form-data to upload an image file under field `image`.

patch.description: Updates product fields by ID. Store owner access required.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of product categories. Supports query params for pagination and filtering.

post.description: Creates a new product category. Admin access required.

get.description: Retrieves a single category by its unique identifier.

patch.description: Updates category fields by ID. Admin access required.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a category by ID. Admin access required.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user\'s shopping cart with line items and totals.

delete.description: Removes all items from the authenticated user\'s cart.

post.description: Adds a product to the authenticated user\'s cart or increases quantity if already present.

patch.description: Updates the quantity of a product in the authenticated user\'s cart.

delete.description: Removes a specific product from the authenticated user\'s cart.

post.description: Creates a new store for the authenticated user. Store owner role will be applied.

get.description: List stores with optional pagination, status filter, and sorting.
Returns details for the authenticated user\'s store.

put.description: Updates store fields for the authenticated store owner.

get.description: Returns the full catalog of subscription plans available in Dokkan, including each plan slug, pricing, and feature set.

get.summary: Get the authenticated store owner\'s current subscription
get.description: Returns the current store, active subscription, and associated plan for the authenticated store owner.

get.summary: Get a plan by slug or UUID
get.description: Looks up a plan using either its stable slug (for example, basic, plus, pro) or its UUID identifier.

post.summary: Send a test order confirmation email
post.description: Sends a compiled Handlebars order confirmation email using provided order data.
Creates a new user account. If the email belongs to a previously soft-deleted account, it restores the account. Role is optional and defaults to Customer.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation failed

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token.

401.description: Invalid email/password or account is deleted

post.description: Rotates the refresh token (from HTTP-only cookie) and returns a fresh access token.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked refresh token

post.description: Revokes current refresh token session (if present) and clears refresh cookie.
Validates the 6-digit code stored in Redis against the user input. Updates account to verified status upon success.

401.description: Access denied. Invalid or missing token.

post.description: Generates a fresh OTP, refreshes the 15-minute timer in Redis, and sends a new email via the local mail service.

200.description: A new verification code has been sent to your email.

401.description: Access denied. Invalid or missing token.

500.description: Internal server error or mail service failure

post.summary: Checkout - place a new order from cart
post.description: Creates an order from the authenticated user\'s Redis cart for the specified store.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all orders. Admin access required.
Returns the authenticated user\'s orders.
Returns orders belonging to a specific store. Store owner or admin access required.
Retrieves a single order by ID. Customers can access their own orders; admins can access all.

put.description: Updates the status of an order. Store owner or admin access required.

post.description: Creates a review for a product the user has purchased. Requires a delivered order containing the product.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of reviews for a specific product.
Returns a single product review by its ID.

put.description: Updates the authenticated user\'s own product review.

delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user\'s own product review.

put.summary: Reply to a product review (Store Owner)
put.description: Allows the store owner to reply to a product review on their store\'s product.

post.description: Creates a review for a store the user has purchased from. Requires a delivered order from the store.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of reviews for a specific store.
Returns a single store review by its ID.

put.description: Updates the authenticated user\'s own store review.

delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user\'s own store review.

put.summary: Reply to a store review (Store Owner)
put.description: Allows the store owner to reply to a review on their store.

get.description: Retrieves the public profile data of the authenticated user.

401.description: Access denied. Invalid or missing token.

patch.description: Updates specific fields on the authenticated user profile. Send multipart/form-data and attach the profile photo in the image field.

400.description: Validation error (e.g., invalid fields, string length exceeded, or no valid fields provided)

401.description: Access denied. Invalid or missing token.

404.description: Account not found or already deleted

delete.description: Performs a soft delete on the authenticated user account.
